headline: A dish with a story, Thanksgiving with culinary historian Michael Twitty
description: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.
subheadings: Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing
What Thanksgiving and this dish mean to Twitty
paragraphs: This Thanksgiving, Morning Edition host Leila Fadel left the studio for her kitchen, where she was met by the two-time James Beard Award winner Michael Twitty, who came with a spice blend, fresh sage…
His book, The Cooking Gene , planted him as one of the nation's foremost chronologists tracing his ancestry through African American culinary history.

Kush is one of Twitty's most beloved Thanksgiving offerings and one he's been making since he was a teen. The name and the ingredients show the way food became a tool for the enslaved in the Americas…
